wrap_compare.note: line wrapping is not compared: where a statement, a list or an enum breaks, where a string literal is split and the indent of the continuation lines; a one-line versus multi-line short body (lambda, function, block, enum, loop, if) is a wrap too where the style's AllowShort...OnASingleLine value permits the join (a body of one statement without comments; an option that forces the form stays exact; brace placement stays exact); everything else is compared exactly (blank lines, braces, spacing, comments, statements of macro bodies, text under clang-format off). Byte-identical files are the secondary number
